notes: visual-qa-log.json verdict was 'issues' with two medium findings, but on triage neither is a code-fixable frontend rendering bug, so no PR was opened (per the prompt: ignore data problems and design-as-intended; abandon rather than ship an unverifiable change on an auto-merging loop).

Finding 1 (Copa del Rey subtitle: raw English '2nd Leg - … lead 1-0 on aggregate' next to Norwegian 'FERDIG'): this is DATA CONTENT in the event's `round` field (sourced from ESPN) rendered correctly by dashboard.js:403. English text in the data is the research/verify/fetcher agents' concern, not the frontend. The rendering code is not at fault. These finished matches have also already rolled off the board as of 2026-10-05, so the strings are no longer present in events.json.

Finding 2 ('HBO Max (Sport) +1' — claimed UK '+1' time-shift suffix): this is a MISDIAGNOSIS. The '+1' is Sportivista's own intentional 'N more streaming options' affordance — dashboard.js:429 renders +${streams.length - 1} when an event has more than one Norwegian channel, and cards.css:201 already styles it fainter + smaller (var(--fg-3), 12px) to separate it from the channel name. It is working as designed and is consistent across the board; changing it would be a DESIGN.md-level decision for the owner, not an auto-merged UI fix.
No truncation, overflow, broken flags/logos, foreign-channel-in-UI, or calm-design breaks were reported, so there is nothing in scope for ui-fix to repair.
